background: flat FLRW fixed point Sigma = K = 0 with q0 = (1+3w)/2, w fixed symbolically
class_mirror: the Bianchi III (hyperbolic 2-plane, epsilon = +1, K > 0) and Kantowski-Sachs (spherical 2-plane, epsilon = -1, K < 0) branches are the SAME reduced RHS with the signature absorbed into the sign of K; the mirror is a separated sign convention, never a new coefficient.
frame: expansion-normalized orthonormal LRS frame (PR-125 registered convention family)
legacy_alignment: conventions identical to the rev-r184 OMK-REOPEN registration; that module is not edited
variables: Sigma (shear-to-expansion), K (curvature parameter; KS mirror carries K < 0)
